contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP M AVRELIVS AVG TRP XXV ; R/ VOTA SOL DECENN COS III

Silver coin. Denarius of Marcus Aurelius (139-180), as kindly identified by the finder, RIC vol. 3 page 232 no. 238, issue of 170-171. Obverse description: Bare shouldered bust laureate right, curly hair and flowing beard, large eye. Obverse inscription: IMP M AVRELIVS AVG TRP XXV. Reverse description: Draped and veiled priest standing left holding patera over narrow altar which looks like a cricket wicket. No bull [pace RIC]. Reverse inscription: VOTA SOL DECENN COS III. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 3.12gms, die axis: 12
